sources.title: Malawi Broadcasting Corporation: Tenders & Documents (updated 27 March 2025)
sources.said: Tender notices and related documents will be published on this page. At present, there are no open tenders. ... Malawi Broadcasting Corporation (MBC) is the only public broadcaster in Malawi and derives its mandate from an Act of Parliament 1964, the Communications Act 1998

figures.finding: Malawi: not attempted today. MBC publishes tenders on its procurement page and had none open (page last updated 27 March 2025). Its TV rate card page served a bot-verification challenge (not counted). Leads from one search (not read): MultiChoice's OneZed and Zambezi Magic channels commission Malawian series (private, not public terms).
